test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following letter series and answer the question.

(Left) T B Y M R E S I C X Z O W A Q D F H G U K (Right)

Which letter is fifth to the right of the twelfth letter from your right end of the given series?
solution:
Given series: (Left) T B Y M R E S I C X Z O W A Q D F H G U K (Right)

According to the question,

1) Twelfth letter from your right end of the given series → (Left) T B Y M R E S I C __**X**__ Z O W A Q D F H G U K (Right) ⇒ X

2) The letter which is fifth to the right of the twelfth letter from your right end of the given series → (Left) T B Y M R E S I C __X__ Z O W A __**Q**__ D F H G U K (Right) ⇒ Q

Thus, Q is fifth to the right of the twelfth letter from your right end of the given series.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
